title: OpenRouter Micro-Tier End-to-End Smoke: Mission Spec to Verified Output via cli-agent
target_platform: Installed cli-agent skill (jev_router.py, openrouter_client.py, smoke_test_openrouter.py) consumed from richfrem/agent-plugins-skills; OpenRouter API
interest_statement: Trivial, repeatable proof that after relocating the router and client out of this repo, a Sanctuary mission spec naming a cheap OpenRouter model still runs start to end through the installed companion skill.
hypothesis: A mission-style task spec that pins a cheap OpenRouter model (meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct) will, through the installed cli-agent skill alone, be routed to TIER_1_MICRO by the zero-token JEV router, executed live by openrouter_client.py without fallback, return exactly the expected JSON output, and increment the local spend ledger, on 3 of 3 consecutive runs at under $0.0001 per run.
falsification_criteria: FALSIFIED if, in any of 3 consecutive runs: (1) routing tier or complexity class differs from the spec; (2) the live call does not return status OK or a fallback triggers; (3) the parsed output differs from expected_output or keys are not sorted; (4) the ledger does not increment; or (5) a run costs more than $0.0001. ABANDONED if no OPENROUTER_API_KEY is available or the installed cli-agent skill lacks the three scripts.
baseline_evidence: Ad-hoc single run on 2026-11-10 from a scratch script passed all four checks (llama-3.2-3b, 100 in / 21 out tokens, $0.0000092, 0.64 s). Not recorded as a mission; this mission makes it a registered, frozen, repeatable result.
experiment: Freeze the spec (references/openrouter-smoke-task.json shape) and evaluator (installed smoke_test_openrouter.py, hash recorded). Run the smoke test 3 times through the installed skill path only (no sibling-clone import). Record per-run route, status, tokens, cost, ledger delta, and output into results.json. Verdict from the frozen criteria.
phases: Three consecutive live runs via installed cli-agent
score_basis: Leverage 2: guards the consumer/companion boundary after the relocation. Depth 1: a smoke test, no new knowledge. Cost 0.25: three sub-cent calls. Friction 1: one command. Priority = (2*1)/(0.25*1) = 8.0.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: None; a failure is a finding, not an escalation.
model_routing.routing_guidance: Routing by the installed jev_router.py; execution by openrouter_client.py with local fallback disabled so a fallback counts as failure.

evidence.details: 3/3 consecutive live runs through the installed cli-agent skill (jev_router + openrouter_client + smoke_test_openrouter, fallback disabled) passed all four checks (route, live OK, exact output, ledger increment) on meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct at $0.0000092/run; freeze.json records spec and evaluator hashes; results.json has per-run data.

lessons_learned: The consumer path (Sanctuary spec -> installed cli-agent) works after relocation; no local copy of the router or client is needed.
One trivial task is a smoke result, not a routing-accuracy claim.
